title: GPU-vs-CPU byte-identity harness (DVB-T2 chain)
description:
## Goal

Property-test harness asserting byte-identity of the four
deterministic columns between CPU-only and CPU+GPU paths on the
DVB-T2 chain at a fixed seed.

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages for gf2-sim pipeline)
within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Property test asserts byte-identity for `fer` /
  `frames` / `errors` / `mean_iters` between CPU-only and
  CPU+GPU paths at fixed seed for ≥3 DVB-T2 MODCOD configurations.

## Non-goals

BER excluded from byte-identity per status-quo contract.
